p: chief fathers of the families of: It seems that the tribes contended who might marry these daughters to have their inheritance: and therefore the sons of Joseph proposed the matter to Moses.
my lord to give the land: Meaning Moses.
jubile of the children of Israel: Signifying that at no time could it return, for in the Jubile all things returned to their own tribes.
well: For the tribe could not have continued, if the inheritance which was the maintenance of it should have been alienated to others.
inheritance in any tribe of the: When there is no male to inherit.
commandments and the judgments: Concerning the ceremonial and judicial laws.
